summary: Requirement A.1.03 (B03) has been fully verified from an End-User and QA perspective. The acceptance criterion ('ساعت نامعلوم ماشین‌آلات صفر قطعی جلوه نکند و تست دقیق اضافه شود') is completely satisfied. In both FILE 4 Excel and bilingual PDF exports, unknown machinery hours remain null/em-dash ('—') and are clearly distinguished from explicit 0 hours. Exact regression tests (test_b03_legacy_equipment_zero_and_unknown_across_exports and test_b03_conflicting_status_and_excess_hours_preserve_source_rows) are implemented and cover all export formats and edge conditions.
